# RVNKQuests Copilot Instructions - Backup

This is a backup of the RVNKQuests copilot instructions from before the content-as-needed strategy split.

Backed up on: October 1, 2025

## Original Content

[The original comprehensive copilot instructions file before being split into topic-specific files]

This file was split into:
- copilot-instructions.md (main file with references)
- copilot-instructions.quest.md (quest development patterns)
- copilot-instructions.objective.md (objective system guidelines)
- copilot-instructions.reward.md (reward system patterns)
- copilot-instructions.trigger.md (event trigger standards)
- copilot-instructions.logging.md (logging standards)
- copilot-instructions.formatting.md (message formatting)
- copilot-instructions.vscode-tasks.md (development workflow)

## Migration Notes

The content-as-needed strategy allows for:
- More focused documentation per topic
- Better maintainability of guidelines
- Clearer separation of concerns
- Easier updates to specific areas

Each topic file focuses on specific implementation patterns while the main file provides high-level guidance and references to detailed topics.
